We are a lean company, but it matters more that you are productive and happy. Use good judgement and you will rarely need to ask anyone before spending.

<CalloutBox icon="IconInfo" title="Quick version" type="info">
Spend company money the way you would spend your own.
</CalloutBox>

## Monthly limit

Every person has a **card limit of $4,000 per month** for software, coworking and training. The limit is a ceiling, not a target. See the [finance page](/handbook/finance) for budgets.

<CompensationCalculator initialJob="Product Engineer" />

## Receipts

All expenses over $75 need an itemized receipt uploaded within 14 days of the charge, together with a short memo explaining the business reason.

| Amount | Receipt needed |
| --- | --- |
| Under $75 | No |
| $75 and over | Yes, within 14 days |

## Reimbursements

If you used a personal card by accident, claim a reimbursement within 90 days with the receipt attached. Mileage can be claimed when you drive for work, but fuel cannot be expensed separately.
